canonical_example.translation: There is no reason to lose your cool; it's not a big deal.

canonical_example.text: Su tristeza nunca cesó con el paso de los años.
canonical_example.translation: Her sadness never ceased with the passing of time.

canonical_example.text: El público no cesaba de gritar.
canonical_example.translation: The audience didn't stop shouting.

canonical_example.text: El gerente cesó en su cargo al enterarse de su enfermedad.
canonical_example.translation: The manager resigned from his position when he found out about his sickness.

canonical_example.text: El comité cesó al subdirector de la preparatoria.
canonical_example.translation: The committee dismissed the high school's vice principal.
